established: Complete unchanged do26/hit12 compose with an actual NPC owner at all nonzero six-bit proc ranks. Root count is(rank+25)/5;failed metadata refuses before server-do/formula/factory,while allocation failure retains its actual earlier flag/formula call.

Hit12 uses the missile owner and retained skill/rank,centers its filter0x88583 search on the missile rather than a moved caster,and excludes the struck GUID. A different selected target receives a fresh same-class child with flags0x21,explicit hit coordinates/target coordinates/owner/rank and budget-1. No target,same target,exhausted budget and allocation failure create no successful child.
services: Skill/count/radius formula,table/stat/world/target-search and allocation leaves are explicit. This executes two complete older bodies with pinned current data,not complete modern target traversal,damage/hit-delay/HP or the shared missile factory.

Child seed/RNG services are intentionally absent from these two bodies and belong to the declared allocator. A future adapter must provide allocation at each actual hop;precomputing/spending all future world draws at cast time would require separate evidence or approval.
limits: No runtime NPC Chain Lightning,proc callback dispatch,skill-list/owner-removal/seed-allocation or current executable parity is claimed. Existing source factory/missile numeric/step services remain separate.
